completion: Normal accepted Result proposal followed by a committed supported D5 checkpoint; other domains/whole-batch finalization outside this diagnostic scope
proposal_review: Model validates/saves its own Result selection. Host inspects the exact returned ProposalReview; approve only if target/report/result scope matches preregistration. Respond through request_proposal_approval bound to that review; retain accepted review and acknowledgment. No fake host state mutation or auto-approval of incompatible selection. No review is accepted during preparation.
continuation: Same original Codex session only, with generic continuation to canonical actionable next_action. No fresh model retries or operator scientific hints. Each continuation preserves all transcript, tool receipts and state.
generic_continuation: Continue the assessment in this same session using get_status and its canonical next action, following the normal rob2-kit guidance.
no_progress_boundaries: Terminal failure with no canonical actionable repair/continuation
Same canonical head and identical unrepaired error/action across two completed generic continuations, without new evidence/search results/coverage or corrected arguments
Internal integrity/output-contract error, corrupted or changed frozen source identity, or unusable transport after canonical recovery
Model declares completion while D5 checkpoint is absent and no supported continuation remains
supervised_alerts: Any proposal scope mismatch or requested acquisition outside frozen corpus
Session ends before D5 commit: inspect canonical state, preserve stop, supervise generic continuation only if actionable
Repeated tool failures or reads with unchanged cursors; do not treat missing receipt/truncation as absence evidence
Usage/time anomaly: alert parent for scope/budget decision rather than silently terminate at arbitrary tool count
